initialize.instructions: BidPilot is an evidence-first B2G pursuit capability. Use list_tenders and get_tender to read the public catalogue, decide to apply the pursuit policy with supplier evidence you actually hold (never invent evidence), and list_runs/replay to read completed Cortex analyses. A REVIEW or NO-GO decision means no proposal is drafted; closed notices are historical.

structured_content.title: Public data quality and API continuity service

tasks.title: Validate that claimed hours do not exceed verified availability window
Confirm all cited credentials match active records in supplier profile
Verify no fabricated project references or outcomes in proposal sections
Ensure proposal sections do not promise deliverables beyond stated opportunity scope
Confirm delivery hours fit within availability window and assign team
Verify supplier eligibility against all stated requirements
Assemble pricing model within delivery-hour envelope
Draft all proposal sections against rubric response plans
Evaluate win strategies and select primary positioning
Bind policy version 2026-08-02.v1 to all decision outputs
Capture run ID lineage linking all derived artifacts to source rows
Record source SHA256 and retrieval timestamp for opportunity data
